verified_facts.text: The Palms is an all-suite resort spanning 12 acres on Grace Bay Beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Palms Turks and Caicos is an exquisite all-suite resort spanning 12 acres at the heart of the famous Grace Bay Beach

verified_facts.text: The resort is on the island of Providenciales, steps from the white sands of Grace Bay Beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: on the island of Providenciales, The Palms Turks and Caicos is recognized as one of the top luxury resorts in the Turks and Caicos Islands. Located just steps away from the flawless white sands and sparkling turquoise waters of Grace Bay Beach

verified_facts.text: The resort has a 25,000-square-foot spa.
verified_facts.excerpt: a 25,000 square foot spa and a state-of-the-art infinity pool

verified_facts.text: The spa takes up an entire acre of the 12-acre property.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Palms is known for its spa, which takes up an entire acre of the 12-acre property

verified_facts.text: At the spa, mornings begin with yoga and pilates classes, and there are cabanas, a sauna and a steam room.
verified_facts.excerpt: Mornings begin with yoga and pilates classes; there are tinkling water features and cabanas to retreat to before or after a treatment; as well as a sauna and steam room

verified_facts.text: The spa offers regionally inspired rituals such as the Mother of Pearl Conch Polish.
verified_facts.excerpt: plus regionally-inspired rituals like the 90-minute ‘Mother of Pearl Conch Polish’

verified_facts.text: A serpentine infinity pool lies at the heart of the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Lying at the heart of The Palms Turks and Caicos luxury resort, the superbly sculpted serpentine infinity pool

verified_facts.text: Life at The Palms centers on the pool, with a swim-up bar, loungers and day beds.
verified_facts.excerpt: Life at The Palms orbits around the pool—and for good reason considering the swim-up bar, swaying palm trees, and ample options of loungers and day beds.

verified_facts.text: All suites have king-sized beds with custom hand-tufted bedding and a coffee and espresso maker.
verified_facts.excerpt: All suites at The Palms Turks and Caicos feature king-sized beds with custom hand-tufted bedding, beautiful bathrooms with quality bathing products, high-speed wi-fi, cable television, DVD/CD player, coffee and espresso maker

verified_facts.text: Many suites have an in-suite washer/dryer and a full kitchen.
verified_facts.excerpt: Many suites also boast an in-suite washer/dryer and a full kitchen, complete with modern appliances.

verified_facts.text: Penthouses have up to four private balconies and a private Sun Suite with outdoor shower.
verified_facts.excerpt: Penthouses feature up to four private balconies as well as a private Sun Suite with outdoor shower.

verified_facts.text: All suites come with spacious balconies, many with ocean views.
verified_facts.excerpt: all suites come with spacious balconies to wind down on after a day of sun, many of which have excellent views of the ocean

verified_facts.text: Guests can use a tennis court and bicycles to explore the area.
verified_facts.excerpt: guests can enjoy the convenience of both a tennis court for some spirited matches and bicycles to explore the surrounding area with ease

verified_facts.text: The resort has a kids club for ages 4 to 12, offering full and half days.
verified_facts.excerpt: has a kids club on site that will accommodate ages 4-12 for both full and half days

verified_facts.text: The children's club is called the Conch Kritters Club.
verified_facts.excerpt: an array of activities keeps both the children and the adults happy, including our Conch Kritters Club

verified_facts.text: The Courtyard Shops offer boutiques and artisanal stores in a courtyard setting.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Palms’ Courtyard Shops, where an array of charming boutiques, upscale retailers, and artisanal stores await

verified_facts.text: The two signature restaurants are Parallel23 and SiSi Restaurante.
verified_facts.excerpt: Two signature restaurants, Parallel23 and SiSi Restaurante along with three stunning bars throughout the resort

verified_facts.text: A 24-hour concierge sets up experiences on the water such as snorkeling or a sunset cruise.
verified_facts.excerpt: a 24-hour concierge to set up experiences on the water (say snorkeling, or a sunset cruise)

verified_facts.text: A butler service makes sure there is a cooler of iced water beside your sun lounger.
verified_facts.excerpt: a butler service that will always make sure there’s a cooler of iced water beside your sun lounger at the start of the day

verified_facts.text: The property provides beach wheelchairs and has elevators, ramps and accessible pathways.
verified_facts.excerpt: The property features elevators, ramps, and accessible pathways, can accommodate guide pets, and provides beach wheelchairs.

verified_facts.text: The Palms opened on Grace Bay Beach in 2005.
verified_facts.excerpt: Its arrival back in 2005 was part of a wider evolution of Turks into the destination it is today

verified_facts.text: Bathrooms have marble floors and showers and deep tubs.
verified_facts.excerpt: with gleaming marble floors and showers, often with two separate heads, and deep tubs to soak in

verified_facts.text: Suites look out either on the Caribbean Ocean or on the landscaped gardens.
verified_facts.excerpt: Whether you select a suite with infinite Caribbean Ocean views or mature meticulously landscaped gardens

verified_facts.text: Families abound at the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Families abound at this resort, which has a kids club on site

subjective.text: The pool is described as one of the best in the Caribbean.
